1.title: Trump’s War on Mail-In Ballots Has Voters Baffled. That May Be the Point.
1.summary: From Oregon to Florida, officials are at once reassuring voters that their ballots are safe and encouraging them to use drop boxes or vote in person.

2.title: Trump Administration Again Asks Supreme Court to Allow Mail Voting Restrictions
2.summary: The filing puts the legality of the president’s push to impose limits on mail voting squarely before the justices even as states begin sending out ballots.

3.title: The Battle to Save General Donahue From Hegseth’s Army Purge
3.summary: Gen. Christopher T. Donahue’s vision for fighting future wars won him powerful supporters around the world. Could they save his career?

4.title: Live Updates: Germany’s Far Right Eyes Breakthrough in Regional Election
4.summary: Victory for the Alternative for Germany party in a vote in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt would propel a far-right party into power for the first time since World War II.

5.title: U.S. Envoys Witkoff and Kushner Arrive in Kyiv After Talks With Putin
5.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were meeting on Sunday with Volodymyr Zelensky in Ukraine, a day after talks with Vladimir V. Putin in Moscow.

6.title: Dozens feared trapped in collapsed building in Delhi
6.summary: As many as 50 people are thought to have been inside the five-storey hostel when it came down.
